macros.name: msheading
macros.doc: If for some reason you wish to deviate from the standard running page headings, you can use the \msheading command to change them.

macros.name: nosubmit
macros.doc: Text or commands inside a \submit command will be used only for submissions, and that in a \nosubmit will be used only for non-submissions.

macros.name: runningtitle
macros.doc: In submission format, a short form of the title is placed in the page header at the top right of each page.

macros.name: sceneseparator
macros.doc: This command inserts the proper scene break character, a centered hash mark (#), in submissions, and a blank line in non-submissions.

macros.name: submit
macros.doc: Text or commands inside a \submit command will be used only for submissions, and that in a \nosubmit will be used only for non-submissions.

macros.name: thought
macros.doc: The \thought command works exactly like \emph, but may be useful to the author for distinguishing between normal italics and italicized thoughts within the source file.

envs.name: synopsis
envs.doc: The only new LaTeX environment in sffms is synopsis, intended for use with novels. In submission mode, the synopsis is typeset single-spaced with roman numerals for page numbers to distinguish it from the rest of the novel.
